title:
POV: I GAVE FLOWERS TO A CHRISTIAN STRANGER
IN ISRAEL
beats: 'Are you Jewish?' 'No.' 'Are you Christian?' 'Yes.' 'Amazing - these are for you. A gift to make your day a bit better.'
'Where are you from?' 'Uganda.' 'How long have you been in Israel?' 'Five years.' 'Welcome to Israel.' ... 'Keep smiling.'
